purpose: Replace resource timing probes to satisfy the user's no-synthetic-input requirement, including performance probes.
original_timing_probe_scope: Previously invented feature values were used only for inference timing, never training, model selection, validation, calibration, or predictive-performance metrics. Those timing values are superseded.
replacement_inputs: The first1000 actual-source adult (age>=18 and<=110) appointments in the chronological pre2020 development frame; single-record timing uses its first row. Rows remain private in memory and are never exported.
training_scope: Resource-only repeats of the same21 frozen configurations. No predictive metrics or hyperparameter choices are changed. Recent-window training boundary is fixed to2020-01-01 independently of timing inputs.
outputs: Only aggregate fit time, process peak RSS and inference latency. Timing-row reuse/overlap with training has no claim of predictive validation.
supplement_protocol_amendment: The earlier supplement_protocol resource clause referring to synthetic timing inputs is superseded by this explicit amendment. All original research model-selection/validation clauses stay unchanged.
